notes.title: The mighty patch is here!
notes.content:
[h1]The latest such update is now available. [/h1]

[h2]What changes have been made? About that below![/h2]

[list]
[*] New side plot thread "John Dee"
[*] Nine hidden puzzle side quests
[*] Additional unique items, monsters and bosses
[*] Ready-made, larger item sets at merchants (ammo, food, potions, etc.)
[*] Rework of reward system and character class development (active from the new game)
[*] Rebalance of damage, life points, special skills and falling items.
[*] Rework of the game difficulty level system (decreasing the difficulty for players on "EASY" level, making the game more difficult in "DIFFICULT" mode and making it much harder in "NIGHTMARE" mode)  
[*] Rework of the in-game price balance (global reduction of item values)
[*] Improved immunity modifier panel
[*] Hundreds of new monster spawners (across the map and various stages of the game)
[*] Optimisation of existing monster zones
[*] Improved final location of the main storyline
[*] Icons for active quests/trades/dialogs at selected NPCs
[*] Names of game world regions
[*] New menu sound and improved combat and movement sounds
[*] Story subtitles for cutscenes
[*] New player tips in tutorial dialogue 
[*] Improved display of modifiers in item descriptions 
[*] New font
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/27f54b4de593aa6f59479fcd2a29cf2d9dde7af0.png[/img]

notes.title: Fall in love with M.E.A.T. on February 14th!
notes.content:
[h1]Valentine's Day with Sir Culligan[/h1]

There's not much time left until the release of the M.E.A.T. Therefore, we refine our game so that on the day of release to provide you with a product of the highest level.

One of the biggest changes is the modified HUD. You have repeatedly pointed out that the previous one was not very legible, because it did not show the value of HP or available Telesarion. Therefore, we have analysed your suggestions and decided to modify it slightly. The effects can be seen below:

[h3]New HUD[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/63713eabb1f957365953e5a505b45e728babb6fc.gif[/img]

[h1]A brand new location for the tutorial![/h1]

As the lion's share of the programming work has been completed, we are now focusing on adding new content to the game. One example is the creation of a completely new location for the tutorial. 

It is during this tutorial that you will have the chance to meet Sir Culligan from the Civil War era. Furthermore, within this sequence, you will learn how to control your character or operate the interface. As a result, once you reach Washagami, you will be able to effectively use the mechanics prepared for you right from the start!

[h3]Piece of new tutorial location[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38078745/6702d2ddb9b0e08f3976439a5dcaa4b4ce12dcf3.png[/img]

[h1]Minor improvements[/h1]

Of course, we are constantly working on the bugs you reported. The game has been changing exponentially over the last few weeks, all thanks to your invaluable support. 

Additionally, we are also implementing a slightly improved lighting system, which will make M.E.A.T. look even more atmospheric!

notes.title: Let it snow, let it snow... OPEN BETA English language version update
notes.content:
[h1]Ho ho ho![/h1]

The latest update of open M.E.A.T. tests is now available:
[list]
[*] Sir Culligan's Christmas skin in Santa's version;
[*] more quests;
[*] English language version of the game [b](please note that the English language version will work only if your operating system language version is not Polish)[/b]

As always - [b]we ask you to report any bugs in our STEAM forum. [/b]Your feedback allows us to improve the game significantly with each subsequent update. You are an invaluable support and as always, we encourage you to take screenshots or share your opinion on the development of the game.

[h2]How to become a tester?[/h2]
If you want to join the group of testers, please send an e-mail to the address: [b]kontakt@meatrpg.com,[/b] by adding "TESTING THE GAME" in the message title, and you will receive a special Steam access code.

[h2]Remember one thing though...[/h2]

...[b]after the end of open BETA tests, the key you received will be automatically deactivated[/b] and access to the game will only be possible if you purchase a full version.

notes.title: Update of M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA TEST!
notes.content:
[h1]Launch newest update of M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA TEST[/h1]

[u]Dear M.E.A.T. Lovers, Sir Culligan's adventurers![/u]

As promised, it is already possible to download the update of the M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA TEST:
[list]
[*] a trading system with NPCs encountered during your journey;
[*] the first quests exploring the M.E.A.T. storyline;
[*] fixing most of the bugs you have submitted;
[*] improved mob selecting mechanics;
[*] selecting a mob using the keyboard button (currently it is the "E" button). 
[/list]
Is this the end of open tests? Nothing could be further from the truth! [b]We are constantly working to provide you with new content and mechanics[/b] in the framework of OPEN BETA, which will give you a full picture of what M.E.A.T. is supposed to be. 

So take your revolvers out of the holster, put on hats, wear comfortable waistcoats, and collect all the necessary items - the M.E.A.T. OPEN BETA 2.0 has just started!

[h2][b]How to become a tester?[/b][/h2]

If you want to join the tester group, please send an e-mail to the address: [b]kontakt@meatrpg.com[/b], adding 'GAME TESTING' in the message title, and you will receive a special Steam access code.

[h2][b]Remember one thing, however...[/b][/h2]

[b]...once the open BETA tests have been completed, the key you have received will be automatically deactivated[/b] and access to the game will only be possible if a full version is purchased by you.
